confirmation: The unchanged five-percentage-point balanced-accuracy target still requires at least twenty unseen dates and a positive paired date-cluster interval. No claim from this screen alone.
dates: The same six development asset/date assessments; labels and decision coverage unchanged.
decision: Argmax of source posterior divided by the declared available class-prior estimate. The evaluation metric remains the mean of the three actual class recalls.
evidence_status: Development only; no independent confirmation yet.
hypothesis: Under covariate shift, accurate conditional posteriors need current-domain class frequencies for balanced-accuracy decisions. Training frequencies can be stale. Under pure label shift the opposite may hold, so this is an empirical ablation rather than an assumed correction.
online: Initialize exponentially discounted class counts from previous noon frequencies, with effective initial mass half_life/log(2). At each decision decay counts, then add earlier labels whose actual future quote has arrived. Normalize and apply a 0.01 floor by mixing with the uniform distribution.
previous_noon: For validation use the last training date noon labels; for assessment use the preceding validation noon labels. No current-session future labels are used.
primary_comparator: Frozen original validation-selected reference with its original training-prior decision rule.
probabilities: Freeze every source posterior. Natural accuracy and log loss cannot change. Only the class decision used for balanced accuracy changes.
selection: Select challenger source and prior policy using only preceding validation balanced accuracy, then natural log loss; apply to the next development date.
stronger_control: Validation-selected original/full-day base reference with the same set of available-prior policies.
